aliases: Yellow Earth Grand World Yellow Earth Dao Field

summary.text: Yellow Earth Great World is Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's yellow great world and Dao field among the three great worlds of Crazed Demon Cave's eighth layer.

claims.text: Cloud people in the eighth-layer void tell Fang Yuan of a bare-footed sage in yellow clothes filled with compassion who saved the Yellow Earth Great World, naming it beside Green Lotus Dao field and Savage Wilderness Great World.

Little Flower, a giant grey fish and Yellow Earth Sage’s disciple, says it left Yellow Earth Grand World to train and cannot find Yellow Earth Dao field from outside. From its memories, Yellow Earth Dao field is vast, dense in earth path dao marks with other dao marks as well, rich in immortal materials and Gu worms including Immortal Gu, and filled with living beings but no humans. Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable arranged it and taught everyone without discrimination; elites who leave cannot find the way back until a breakthrough lets the Dao field pick them up. Dao fields war with each other, and their nurtured beings invade rival fields.

Lu Wei Yin explains that Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable created Green Lotus Dao field in the eighth layer of Crazed Demon Cave, Reckless Savage Demon Venerable created Savage Wilderness Great World, and Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable made Yellow Earth Great World.

Fang Yuan asks whether Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable created Yellow Earth Great World so that helping Fang Yuan become venerable would also aid Paradise Earth’s revival. Lu Wei Yin agrees and places Northern Plains’ Paradise Earth true inheritance inside Yellow Earth Great World, while naming other regional Paradise Earth true inheritances elsewhere.

Lu Wei Yin knows Yellow Earth Great World’s location. When he and Fang Yuan reach it, the three great-world bubbles sit joint at the void’s center in green, yellow, and red, and Yellow Earth is under joint attack from the other two. Yellow light lets them enter. At the world’s center a huge mound is Tomb Earth of the Ten Earths, with a tombstone reading Tomb of Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable; the Sacred Tomb shines and Yellow Earth Great World’s people call their sage arrived.

Yellow Earth Great World has fewer Gu Immortals than Green Lotus Great World. The three great worlds were made one after another: Savage Wilderness has the longest history, Green Lotus is second, and Yellow Earth is the most recent because Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable was the most recent venerable. A huge tunnel connects Yellow Earth Great World and Green Lotus Great World. Yellow Earth Gu Immortals who kneel at the Sacred Tomb are beasts, plants, or other non-human forms, with no pure humans among them.

Heaven Extremity Gai Mei states that Yellow Earth Great World was the arrangement of Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable from the beginning, just as Green Lotus Great World was created by Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable.

Narration of the Crazed Demon Cave contest names Yellow Earth Great World’s Paradise Earth as one of the three parties, alongside Green Lotus Great World’s Heavenly Court and Savage Wilderness Great World’s Longevity Heaven.
